"Usual risk nahi loge toh ordinary par settle."
Agar simple explain nahi, understanding abhi nahi.
"Soch bovo, action kaat lo."
Vision rakho.
Mindset sab kuch hai.
Rengho, chalo, daudo—bas move karte raho.
Tumhe badi shiddat se chahiye.
"Chup chaap mehnat; success shor machayegi."
"Iron garam hone ka wait mat karo."
Goal pe nazar rakho.
Urja se bhare raho.
Matter yeh nahi karta tum kahan se aa rahe ho, matter yeh karta hai tum kahan ja rahe ho.
